Two devices accessing data on a physical remote cloud server.

questions.prompt: Virtual memory typically uses space on:
Cloud data is physically stored on:
Name the memory-management technique that moves fixed-size pages between RAM and secondary storage.
Give the abbreviation for random access memory.
Explain why a computer may become slower when it uses virtual memory heavily.
questions.model_answer: Some required pages are stored on secondary storage instead of RAM. Reading/writing pages on secondary storage is slower than accessing RAM.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Some required pages are stored on secondary storage instead of RAM.
1: Reading/writing pages on secondary storage is slower than accessing RAM.
questions.student_guidance:
Identify where less-used memory pages go when RAM is full.
Compare the access speeds of the two storage locations.

questions.prompt: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of cloud storage compared with local storage.
questions.model_answer: Cloud storage enables remote access or off-site copies/collaboration. It may require internet access, cost fees, or raise privacy/security concerns.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Cloud storage enables remote access or off-site copies/collaboration.
1: It may require internet access, cost fees, or raise privacy/security concerns.
questions.student_guidance:
Consider how a student might access the same file from another location.
Consider a dependency or risk introduced by remote storage.
